title: Grilled Shushka Peppers Stuffed with Red Quinoa, Portobello and Tofu
subtitle: with basil and roasted pepper
description: Mild shushka peppers stuffed with red quinoa, portobello mushrooms, tofu spread, basil and roasted pepper, then grilled over a hot barbecue.

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion in a pan until golden. Add the chopped mushrooms, stir and transfer to a separate bowl.
Add the quinoa, tofu spread, roasted pepper spread and basil, season with salt and white pepper and mix to a uniform filling.
Cut an opening (like a small lid) at the stem end of each pepper and remove the seeds. Rub the peppers with olive oil and fill with the mixture.
Place the stuffed peppers on a hot grill for about 5 minutes on each side.
